disclaimer.short: Informational screening only — not a fatwa. Methodologies and scholarly interpretations differ. Financial analysis is not personalized investment advice.
disclaimer.full: This application provides informational stock analysis and Shariah screening based on selected, documented methodologies and publicly available information. It is not a fatwa, does not constitute an individualized religious ruling, and does not represent itself as a Shariah authority. Different scholars, institutions, and methodologies may reach different conclusions. Financial data and screening results can change as new disclosures and methodology updates become available. Users seeking religious guidance for their personal circumstances should consult a qualified Shariah scholar or advisory body. Investment-related analysis is informational and is not personalized investment advice. Investing involves risk, including loss of capital.

governed.adminIntro: Maintain documented rules, test evidence, workflow decisions, and public visibility. Finalized version content remains fixed.
governed.noMethodologiesBody: Create a methodology record to begin documenting a governed rule set.
governed.noVersions: No versions have been recorded for this methodology.
governed.cloneNote: Version fields are prefilled from the selected source. Criteria are copied with new identities; analyst cases must be authored again against those new IDs.
governed.purificationHelp: Leave blank for null. Enter a JSON object only when this methodology version defines stored treatment data. No generic formula is applied.
governed.visibilitySeparate: Public visibility is controlled separately after the draft is created.
governed.label: Label
governed.requiredActivityItems: Evaluator requirements are enforced by the contract. These category lists are stored as criterion rule data.
governed.criterionIdentityHelp: Identities are fixed by the system and are required when analyst cases refer to expected criterion outcomes.
governed.invalidJsonObject: Enter a valid JSON object or leave the field blank.
governed.invalidCasesJson: Enter a valid JSON array of analyst cases.
governed.analystCasesHint: Author version-specific evidence and expected outcomes before the test gate.
governed.caseInstructions: Use the contract shape below with real security, period, source, fact, and segment identities. The inserted sample has no financial evidence and does not represent a passing case.
governed.caseCriteriaHint: Expected criterion outcomes must use the exact criterion IDs listed here. A cloned version has new IDs and requires new expected-results keys.
governed.addCriteriaFirst: Add and save criteria before authoring cases.
governed.casesFinalized: Analyst cases are finalized with this version and are shown read-only.
governed.finalizedContentReadOnly: Finalized content is read-only. Create a new draft to change methodology content.
governed.editorReadOnly: Editors can review this record but cannot change governance data.
governed.visibilityHelp: This changes anonymous visibility for this version only. Only versions marked public appear in public methodology pages.
governed.noCriteria: No criteria are recorded for this version.
governed.workflowSequential: Advance one stage at a time. Source verification, rules, tests, universe comparison, human review, and approval are checked by the server.
governed.confirmPublish: Make this version visible on the public methodology pages?
governed.confirmUnpublish: Remove this version from the public methodology pages?
governed.confirmProduction: Enable this methodology version for production? This is a separate audited operation.
governed.confirmDeleteCriterion: Delete this draft criterion? This cannot be undone.
governed.noReports: No reports have been recorded for this version yet.
governed.noCoverageGaps: No missing required outcome coverage was recorded.
